name: Qiskit 2.x Compliance Check
description: Auto-validates that saved Python files don't use deprecated Qiskit APIs (opflow, PauliSumOp, transpile(), Primitives V1, HEA, p>2).

then.prompt: Review the saved file for deprecated Qiskit APIs. Flag any usage of: PauliSumOp or opflow (use SparsePauliOp), 'from qiskit.algorithms import' (use 'from qiskit_algorithms import'), qiskit.execute() or Aer.get_backend() (use Primitives V2), backend.run() (use EstimatorV2), transpile() (use generate_preset_pass_manager), Primitives V1 patterns, HEA ansatz (only HVA allowed), p_layers > 2 (Mele et al. constraint). If violations found, suggest the correct Qiskit 2.x replacement. If no violations, respond with '✅ Qiskit 2.x compliant'.
